meta.name: Selemene Engine — MVP Remaining Tasks
meta.description: Only the remaining work needed to ship confidently to real users

tasks.title: Rotate JWT secret, remove hardcoded value from scripts
tasks.description: The JWT secret is hardcoded in deployment/test scripts. Rotate to a new secret and ensure it's only loaded from environment variables.

tasks.title: Fix OpenTelemetry version mismatch in Cargo.toml
tasks.description: OpenTelemetry crate versions are mismatched across workspace members, causing compilation warnings and potential runtime issues. Align all otel crates to compatible versions.

tasks.title: Fix noesis-vedic-api todo!() panics (lines 308, 313)
tasks.description: Two todo!() macros in noesis-vedic-api will panic at runtime if those code paths are hit. Replace with proper error handling or implement the missing logic.

tasks.title: Improve CI secret scanning (beyond rustsec)
tasks.description: Current CI only runs cargo-audit (rustsec). Add secret scanning (e.g., trufflehog or gitleaks) to catch hardcoded credentials in source.

tasks.title: Re-enable Redis L2 cache operations (8 TODOs)
tasks.description: There are 8 TODO comments in the cache crate where Redis L2 operations are stubbed out. Implement the actual Redis get/set/invalidate logic using the existing redis connection pool.

tasks.title: Add PostgreSQL service to CI pipeline
tasks.description: CI currently has no PostgreSQL service, so sqlx integration tests are skipped. Add a Postgres service container to the GitHub Actions workflow.

tasks.title: Fix integration test SIGTRAP on cleanup
tasks.description: Integration tests pass individually but SIGTRAP during cleanup when run together. Likely a double-free or connection pool teardown issue. Investigate and fix.

tasks.title: Add Redis L2 cache integration tests
tasks.description: After MVP-05 re-enables Redis L2, add integration tests that verify cache hit/miss/invalidation behavior with a real Redis instance.

tasks.title: Commit P1-S2 observability changes (already written)
tasks.description: Observability improvements (metrics, cache instrumentation) are already written but uncommitted in the working tree. Review and commit them.

tasks.title: Add FreeAstrologyAPI health check to readiness probe
tasks.description: The /health/ready endpoint checks DB and Redis but not the FreeAstrologyAPI dependency. Add a lightweight health check for the external API.

tasks.title: Implement decision-support workflow synthesizer
tasks.description: Implement the decision-support workflow that synthesizes outputs from multiple engines (panchanga, numerology, human-design) into actionable decision guidance.

tasks.title: Implement self-inquiry workflow synthesizer
tasks.description: Implement the self-inquiry workflow that combines gene-keys, human-design, and numerology engines for introspective guidance.

tasks.title: Implement creative-expression workflow synthesizer
tasks.description: Implement the creative-expression workflow synthesizer that combines relevant engine outputs for creative/artistic guidance.

tasks.title: Implement full-spectrum workflow synthesizer
tasks.description: Implement the full-spectrum workflow that orchestrates all engines together for comprehensive life guidance synthesis.

tasks.title: Standardize consciousness level integration
tasks.description: Standardize how consciousness levels (from gene-keys, human-design) are represented and integrated across all workflow synthesizers.

tasks.title: Add workflow synthesis integration tests
tasks.description: Write integration tests for all four workflow synthesizers, verifying correct engine orchestration and output synthesis.

tasks.title: Write user management endpoint tests
tasks.description: Write comprehensive tests for user management API endpoints (CRUD, password change, profile update, etc.).

tasks.title: Update OpenAPI spec for all endpoints
tasks.description: Update the OpenAPI specification to accurately document all current endpoints, request/response schemas, and authentication requirements.

tasks.title: Core engine validation tests (panchang, HD, numerology accuracy)
tasks.description: Write validation tests for core engine accuracy: panchanga tithi/nakshatra calculations, Human Design type/authority/profile, and numerology life path/expression numbers against known reference data.

tasks.title: End-to-end Railway deploy validation
tasks.description: Perform a full end-to-end deployment to Railway, verifying health checks, env var loading, graceful degradation, and core API functionality.

tasks.title: Basic load test baseline (k6 or similar)
tasks.description: Establish a baseline load test using k6 or similar tool. Target: confirm the server handles expected MVP traffic without errors or degradation.

tasks.title: Verify release pipeline end-to-end
tasks.description: Verify the full CI/CD release pipeline: push to main -> CI passes -> Docker build -> Railway deploy -> health check green.
